paired_patient_cluster_bootstrap.unit: patient_id cluster; repeated ECGs sampled together

representation.backbone: frozen public V3F backbone; no backbone updates
representation.embedding: temporal token mean and max over all 10-second windows, concatenated to 1280 dimensions
representation.preprocessing: 500 Hz native; third-order 0.5-45 Hz causal Butterworth; polyphase resample to 125 Hz; per-lead z-score; 10-second window with 2-second context padding
representation.window_schedule: 10 seconds; 5-second stride; reconstructed rhythm preprocessing; all windows of a record pooled

scope: Exploratory development/adaptation on previously observed SPH; not independent, external, confirmatory, clinical, or prospective validation.

signal_quality.technical_amplitude_rule: finite values and at least one non-flat lead
signal_quality.unit: source amplitude units are not documented as mV; values are unitless

source.name: SPH ECG dataset V1
source.reference: AHA code 30 present on an ECG; absence is statement-not-recorded, not disease-negative
